_meta.method: Web research. ADR is revenue per room sold (STR/CoStar definition), excluding taxes unless noted. null means no authoritative published figure was found; nothing is estimated. Tax entries are what a guest pays per night on top of (or, where noted, inside) the room rate.
_meta.adrNote: Scopes differ between cities (whole market vs CBD vs chain-hotel panel), so figures are not strictly comparable across cities. Each entry's 'scope' says what it covers.

us-ny-newyork.scope: All hotels, New York City market (CoStar top-25 market). NYC Tourism + Conventions reports the same year as $334, occupancy 84.2%.

taxes.name: NYS + NYC sales tax
taxes.basis: percent of room rate

taxes.name: NYC Hotel Room Occupancy Tax
taxes.basis: percent of room rate

taxes.name: NYC hotel occupancy unit charge
taxes.basis: per room per night for rooms renting at $40+/night (graduated $0.50-$1.50 below $40)

taxes.name: NYS Hotel Unit Fee (Javits Center fee)
taxes.basis: per room per night, NYC only

shortTerm.period: trailing 12 months shown on AirDNA overview, retrieved 2026-09
rules: Local Law 18 of 2022 (enforced from 5 Sep 2023): stays under 30 days need registration with the Mayor's Office of Special Enforcement; platforms may not process bookings for unregistered listings.
Host must be a permanent resident present during the stay; at most 2 paying guests; whole-unit rentals under 30 days effectively barred in most multiple dwellings.
Intro 1107 (Nov 2024) would allow 1-2 family homes to rent without host present; no evidence it has passed.

taxes.name: Los Angeles Tourism Marketing District assessment

uk-eng-london.scope: London hotels, Knight Frank (HotStats-based panel, skewed to upscale). 2025 full year reported as 'broadly in line with 2024' with occupancy 82.5%, but no 2025 £ figure published. PwC (STR-based, all classes) forecasts 2026 at £193.50, a different panel.

taxes.name: VAT
taxes.basis: included in quoted price

taxes.name: Overnight visitor levy
taxes.basis: Not in force. Government plans legislation letting English mayors levy one; Mayor Khan said London's would not exceed 5% (Sep 2026).

rules: 90-night rule: entire homes in Greater London may be let for under 90 nights a calendar year without planning permission for change of use (Greater London Council (General Powers) Act 1973 s.25A, inserted by Deregulation Act 2015 s.44).

taxes.name: HST

taxes.name: Municipal Accommodation Tax
taxes.basis: percent of room rate; was 8.5% for stays 1 Jun 2025 - 31 Jul 2026 (World Cup), back to 6% from 1 Aug 2026

rules: Primary residence: limit cut from 120 to 90 nights/year from 1 Jan 2025 (Conseil de Paris, under loi Le Meur of Nov 2024); platforms must block calendars at the cap; fines up to €15,000.
Secondary residences need change-of-use authorisation with compensation; all furnished tourist lets need a registration number.

es-md-madrid.scope: Madrid tourist point, all hotel categories, INE. Computed here as the unweighted mean of INE's 12 monthly 2025 ADRs (range €138.79 Aug - €202.87 Oct); INE does not publish an annual figure, and a room-night-weighted mean would differ slightly.

taxes.name: IVA on accommodation

taxes.name: Tourist tax

uncertain: us-ca-losangeles: no calendar-2025 ADR found; $196 is 12 months to Nov 2025 from a secondary CoStar-based article.

us-ma-boston: $232 is CoStar's broad eastern-Massachusetts market; the Boston/Cambridge core figure ($301.97, 77.3% occ.) comes from a blog (stay-in-boston.com) attributing it to Pinnacle Advisory/Meet Boston and could not be verified.

us-ct-newhaven: no ADR for New Haven or Connecticut found; GSA per diem given only as a proxy.

jp-13-tokyo: 34,800 yen comes from a secondary site citing STR; primary CoStar release not found.
es-md-madrid: 2025 figure is an unweighted mean of INE monthly values computed for this file.

br-27-saopaulo: HotelInvest/FOHB values may be inflation-adjusted (the prior edition stated real Jan-2025 reais) and cover a chain-hotel panel only; ABIH-SP state-level data showed Dec 2025 ADR R$539.25 and +14.46% for 2025.
de-be-berlin, kr-11-seoul, mx-cmx-mexicocity, nz-akl-auckland, is-39-reykjavik, lv-25-riga: no authoritative full-year hotel ADR found.
Short-term rental ADRs (AirDNA) are trailing-12-month dashboard values read in Sep 2026 and shown in USD by AirDNA; AirDNA includes cleaning fees in ADR.
lv-25-riga: 2026 fee stated as €1 incl. VAT by one source and €0.89 ex-VAT by the city; both consistent.
